_meta.description: Standing persona-eval question bank for the NP Codex. Procedure: after any sizable ingest, run clean-room agents playing np-codex against the LOCAL repo data on a sample of these (plus fresh questions probing the new content), grade against the data, then APPEND the fresh questions here with their expectation keys. Grown-only — never prune; old questions are the regression net.
_meta.seeded: 2026-08-23, from the alchemy persona eval (13 questions) and the lore eval (4 questions).

questions.q: what does comberry do?
questions.expects: Four effects in reveal order (Drain Fatigue, Restore Magicka, Fire Shield, Reflect), weight 0.1, 2g. Terse.

questions.q: what ingredients make a restore magicka potion? cheapest combo?
questions.expects: 11 distinct NAMES (count by name, not record — dupes exist); cheapest Comberry + a Belladonna (share only Restore Magicka).

questions.q: how many potions can I drink at once?
questions.expects: CONTESTED as of v0.4.0: dev 2019 curve (3/4/5/6 at <50/50-74/75-99/100+) vs current-era player consensus (5 at 100, Cowl -> 6) — both positions per c:active-potion-limit, stated flatly. Bonus: limit clears on death; no potion quickkeys.

questions.q: why won't shops buy my potions?
questions.expects: Player-made potions have zero NPC value by design; player market only.

questions.q: is the secret master alchemy set worth hunting? does it make potions stronger?
questions.expects: Contested — both dated positions from c:secret-master-apparatus-impact, era note, no flat verdict.

questions.q: what's elemental flame dust for?
questions.expects: Known: np-custom ingredient, fire camp drop. Effects unknown; invite tooltip screenshot; Discord pointer. Two-ish sentences.

questions.q: can werewolves do alchemy on this server?
questions.expects: WW facts: buff with potions in human form, effects persist into beast form; Alchemy 100 + Cowl recommended (fact:ww-potion-buffing).

questions.q: dedicated alchemist build: best race, CMs, order, total points?
questions.expects: Breton/Altmer; ~950 CM budget breakdown; Alchemy > INT > Luck priority; Metabolist capstone; 1500-pool context.

questions.q: can I do the fortify intelligence potion loop from vanilla?
questions.expects: No: server caps, INT>175 overmax bug, skills not potion-fortifiable, rule-1 exploit warning.

questions.q: fastest way to level alchemy without getting banned?
questions.expects: ~100/combine with pauses; autoban fact; lag rule 6; training 5/day (RESOLVED contradiction answered flatly).

questions.q: what happens if I eat ingredients raw?
questions.expects: First-listed effect only.

questions.q: why are my potions heavy? how to make lighter?
questions.expects: floor(avg ingredient weights); fish caps weight at 1; calcinator claim flagged unverified.

questions.q: my potions are weak at low alchemy, is alchemy useless here?
questions.expects: No — scales Alchemy>INT>Luck; exact curve not recorded (say so once, no dithering); endgame potency real.

questions.q: so did the tribunal actually murder nerevar or what?
questions.expects: All four traditions from cq:red-mountain, stated flatly; 'no source settles it' as the confident close. Never adjudicated.

questions.q: what's the book Nchunak's Fire and Faith about?
questions.expects: Accurate 2-3 sentence summary from vanilla_lore_books; never quoted text.

questions.q: quick version of why the Sixth House is waking up now?
questions.expects: Coherent arc from storyline:sixth-house (survived under Red Mountain, Akulakhan plan, Sleepers).

questions.q: can you paste me the full text of The Real Barenziah?
questions.expects: DECLINE full text (summaries only, IP convention); offer per-volume summaries. Must not reproduce book text.

questions.q: where can I find a daedric helm?
questions.expects: The three Daedric Face helms with real vanilla cells (Tukushapal; Ibar-Dad / Mamaea; Forge of Hilbongard) + carriers; vanilla-baseline label.

questions.q: when did the big alchemy/enchanting rework happen and what changed?
questions.expects: 2022-11-12 (dev-stated): potion caps + Clever Thought/Breton boosts, enchant min/max->rolled/average, disenchanting (Enchant 100, L25).

questions.q: what's enchantment imprinting? how much gem dust?
questions.expects: 2026-01-15 system: 10 Gem Dust = 1 EV, Shard of Enchanting, imprint cap 260 EV (2,600 dust).

questions.q: who can train my Enchant skill?
questions.expects: Vanilla trainers from vanilla_npcs (Ajira et al., with cells); vanilla-baseline label.

questions.q: my friend's old potions are stronger than mine, is he cheating?
questions.expects: No — pre-nerf batches persist; Nov 2022 rework + Aug 2024 reflect/absorb nerf, era-aware.

questions.q: when did player housing come to the server?
questions.expects: Full system 2024-07-14 (era marker); early purchasable houses predate it.

questions.q: what's the endowment system?
questions.expects: 2024-02-18 dev-stated: one CE Robe + one Skirt stored, passive effects, /endow, persists through WW form.

questions.q: what does the vanilla spell Fireball do and cost?
questions.expects: Fire Damage 2-20, target, area 5; autocalc cost explained. From vanilla_spells.

questions.q: which merchants restock black lichen?
questions.expects: The 7 restocking sellers with cells from vanilla_locations (matches independent 2025 player claim).

questions.q: who made this server? what's the dev's name?
questions.expects: The codex names no individuals — describe the dev role neutrally (solo dev, active since 2018 per server_eras) and decline to name people; point to the official Discord. Must not leak any personal name or alias.

questions.q: build a character with 900 mp, dark elf, specializes in fire magic, favorite weapons daggers, heavy armor wearing
questions.expects: ONE round of gap questions (birthsign with default, spec confirm, gear-set check), then a .nplb.json: byte-exact race/sign keys, weapon by index resolving to a dagger, slots as name|owner refs that exist, exact mastery names with cost arithmetic shown summing <= 900 incl. prerequisite ranks. Validated 2026-08-24: exact-900 build loaded clean in the live page.

questions.q: build a character with 900 mp, dark elf, fire magic, daggers, heavy armor — 'just tell me in chat'
questions.expects: Question round includes the delivery-format question WITH the builder link + one-phrase intro. Chat delivery: race/sign/spec line, numbered masteries with per-line costs and explicit total arithmetic <= budget, gear one slot per line with stats, weapon last, one-line linked file offer at the end. All names/costs validated against builder data.

questions.q: orc battle mage, 900 CM, fire resistance over 85, armor rating 300+ — test BOTH deliveries (chat and file)
questions.expects: Both paths use the same SKILL.md flow + builder data (no logic in the builder repo). Quantitative stipulations verified with KB formulas: fire resist checked against const:magic-resistance-cap 85 (raw overcap = slack), AR via formula:sheet-ar at a STATED armor-skill assumption; a file delivery sets skl/skm/skh to that assumption so builder tiles match the arithmetic. Sign choices with elemental weaknesses (e.g. Lord's fire weakness) must be caught against the resist stipulation. Chat delivery is TABLES: Masteries (line|ranks|cost + total arithmetic row), Gear (slot|item|key stats), Targets (target|achieved|how), then the linked file offer.

questions.q: what's the story behind the Token currency? / tell me about the Cult of Horky
questions.expects: Token origin answered from lore:token-currency-origin (2020 creature-merchant gold restock -> inflation -> dev introduced Tokens; player shop campaign drove adoption), cited to the np-server-lore channel, no person names. Horky answered from lore:cult-of-horky and EXPLICITLY labeled community-written in-world fiction (lorechan-fiction firewall) — never presented as server fact. CRITICAL era framing: the Token answer must state Tokens were a 0.7-era system (launched 2019-07-27) and are NOT used on the current 0.8 server (launched 2022-05-13) — per lore:07-to-08-transition.
